title: Per Diem Day-Count Convention for Trade-In Shortfall Payments
content:
The coverage accrual days, the days for which the latest payoff quote's per diem is charged in a **Trade-In Agreements** customer's shortfall payment, depend on how long that quote was good for, counted in calendar days from its quote date to its good-through date.

## Convention

| Latest quote good for | Per diem accrues |
|---|---|
| No more than 2 days | For each calendar day after its quote date through the day of payment |
| More than 2 days but no more than 5 days | From its good-through date itself through the day of payment, both days counted |
| More than 5 days | For each calendar day after its good-through date through the day of payment |

None of these counts falls below none.

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates, payment on the 9th)

| Quote date | Good-through date | Good for | Accrual days |
|---|---|---|---|
| The 1st | The 3rd | 2 days | 8 (the 2nd through the 9th) |
| The 1st | The 4th | 3 days | 6 (the 4th through the 9th, both counted) |
| The 1st | The 6th | 5 days | 4 (the 6th through the 9th, both counted) |
| The 1st | The 7th | 6 days | 2 (the 8th and the 9th) |
| The 1st | The 12th | 11 days | 0 (payment before the good-through date) |

## Reading the boundaries

A quote good for exactly 2 days falls in the first row; one good for exactly 5 days falls in the second row, where the good-through date itself is counted.
